title: Card brand detection and IBAN validation
prompt:
Checkout needs two more checks in payment_checks.py.

1. card_brand(number) takes a card number as a string and returns "visa", "mastercard", "amex" or "discover", or None when the number is not a valid card of one of those brands. Spaces and hyphens are separators and are ignored; any other non-digit character makes the number invalid (None). The digits must pass the Luhn checksum, and then must match a brand's prefix and length:
- amex: starts with 34 or 37, 15 digits
- visa: starts with 4, 13, 16 or 19 digits
- mastercard: first two digits 51 to 55, or first four digits 2221 to 2720, 16 digits
- discover: starts with 6011, 65, or 644 to 649, 16 or 19 digits
A Luhn-valid number that matches no brand (wrong prefix, or right prefix with a length not listed for that brand) returns None. An empty string returns None.

2. is_valid_iban(iban) returns True or False. Spaces are ignored and letters may be in either case; any other separator (hyphen, dot, ...) makes it invalid. After removing spaces it must be two letters (country code), two digits (check digits), then letters and digits only. The country must be in IBAN_LENGTHS from iban_countries.py and the total length must match that table exactly; unknown countries are invalid. Finally the standard mod-97 check: move the first four characters to the end, replace each letter with two digits (A=10 ... Z=35), and the resulting integer mod 97 must equal 1. For example "GB82 WEST 1234 5698 7654 32" is valid.

Both functions raise TypeError if the argument is not a str. Please keep the existing helpers working.
acceptance: card_brand: each brand by prefix and every allowed length, mastercard 2-series boundaries (2221, 2720 accepted; 2220, 2721 rejected), discover 644-649 and 65, separators ignored, other characters rejected, Luhn failures, Luhn-valid unknown prefix or wrong length gives None, empty string, TypeError. is_valid_iban: valid IBANs in several countries, lowercase and spaces, bad checksum, wrong length, unknown country, hyphens rejected, non-digit check digits, empty string, TypeError.
difficulty_rationale: Two validators with several interacting rules (separators, checksum, prefix ranges and per-brand lengths, country length table) and many boundary cases.
